Article.ArticleTitle: Detecting duplicate individual case safety reports with record linkage and machine learning.

Abstract.AbstractText: Duplicate reports distort safety signal detection in spontaneous reporting databases.
We developed a machine learning classifier that combines record linkage features from case reports.
Using 12,000 report pairs annotated by safety physicians, the classifier achieved an F1 score of 0.91 on an independent validation dataset from a second national database.
Automated duplicate detection could reduce manual review.

Article.ArticleTitle: Deployment of an NLP pipeline for MedDRA auto-coding in routine case processing.

Abstract.AbstractText: We describe a natural language processing pipeline for MedDRA coding of adverse event verbatim terms. The pipeline was deployed in routine case processing at a global safety department in 2025. Over six months, coders accepted 83% of suggested preferred terms. These results indicate that auto-coding can be used in operational settings with human review.
